name: 3D Volume Mipmap Generation (Compute Shader)
definition: Generates a lower-resolution mipmap level from a 3D texture by averaging 8 adjacent texels using a 2x2x2 box filter in a compute shader.
summary: This method generates 3D mipmap chains via compute shaders using 2x2x2 box filters, specifically designed for sparse textures where hardware generation is unsupported.
